svg.text: Post-click agent for ChatGPT Ads inside Razorpay Engage. The model decides and explains; code computes every number.
Context chip, AI-curated rail with reasons,
Runtime agent · /api/chat (streams to the shop and to the AI console as a structured trace)
10 tools: deterministic code over verified data; the model chooses and explains, never computes
Offers Engine: offers, caps, bank offers
Magic Checkout RTO risk by pincode
5. Proposals for the merchant → (numbers in code)
Approvals act in code, never via the model:
attribute, rail rule, pause, new ad group
Closed loop: approved proposal → new ad group / feed attribute → Engage campaign agent → new ChatGPT ad → new page
70 cases across 13 categories (tool use, groundedness, claim safety, handoff, Hinglish, injection, offer-cap abuse…) · rule checks + a separate Gemini Pro judge
Safety gate: claim safety, groundedness and no-ChatGPT-mention must pass 100% of rule checks or the run exits 1
